question: I need a new laptop. What can I afford?
title: What a laptop does to your days

cells.title: The engine's limits and laptops in Finnish shops now
cells.code:
rng = kori.afford_range()
um = kori.usual_month()
comf, tight, poss = rng["comfortable_up_to"], rng["tight_up_to"], rng["possible_up_to"]
left_over = um["left_over"]

emit("comfortable_up_to", comf, "eur", "Keeps your usual pace up to")
emit("tight_up_to", tight, "eur", "Fits with tighter days up to")
emit("possible_up_to", poss, "eur", "The most that fits before payday")
emit("safe_to_spend", rng["safe_to_spend"], "eur", "Safe to spend")
emit("per_day_now", rng["per_day_now"], "eur_per_day", "Your pace a day now")
emit("usual_per_day", rng["usual_per_day"], "eur_per_day", "Your usual day")
emit("days_to_payday", rng["days_to_payday"], "days", "Days to payday")
emit("left_over_monthly", round(left_over, 2), "eur_per_month", "A usual month leaves")

steps = []
for p in sorted({200, comf, 500, tight, 900, poss}):
    if 0 < p <= poss:
        a = kori.afford(p, "laptop")
        steps.append({"price": p, "verdict": a["verdict"], "per_day_after": a["per_day"]["after"], "safe_after": a["safe"]["after"],
                      "months_to_save": math.ceil(p / left_over) if left_over > 0 else 0})
table("price_steps", steps, "What a price does to your days")
emit("start_step", next((i for i, r in enumerate(steps) if r["price"] == comf), 0), "count", "Where the price picker starts")

prods = web.products("laptop under 800 euros", n=5)
rows = []
for i, pr in enumerate(prods):
    a = kori.afford(pr["price"], pr["name"])
    rows.append({"product": f"p{i + 1}", "name": pr["name"], "price": pr["price"], "store": pr["store"], "verdict": a["verdict"],
                 "per_day_after": a["per_day"]["after"], "url": pr["url"]})
if prods:
    show(prods)
table("laptop_options", rows, "Laptops in Finnish shops, checked against your payday")

if comf > 0 and tight > comf:            # no room before payday: no kept answer, the question is worked out fresh
    text = f"Up to **{eur(comf)}** keeps your usual pace until payday. Up to {eur(tight)} fits, with tighter days."
    if left_over > 0:
        text += f" Or set aside the {eur(left_over)} a usual month leaves and buy it later."
    if (me.get("age") or 0) >= 68:       # a pension, not pay
        text = text.replace("payday", "pension day").replace("palkkapäiv", "eläkepäiv")
    say(text)
